text: 路透调查：所有13位受访经济学家预计匈牙利央行将在8月25日将基准利率下调25个基点至5.5%。分析师预测中位数显示，匈牙利基准利率将在2026年底降至5.0%（与7月预测相同）。
text_en: Reuters poll: All 13 economists surveyed expect Hungary's central bank to cut its benchmark rate by 25 basis points to 5.5% on August 25. The median analyst forecast shows Hungary's benchmark rate falling to 5.0% by end-2026 (unchanged from the July forecast).
